title: Why your phone charges slower after 80%
caption:
Your phone sprints to 80% and then crawls. It is not the charger being lazy, it is protecting the battery.

#tech #howitworks #battery #smartphone #explained

scenes.narration: Your phone races to eighty percent, then crawls. Here's why.
Most people think the charger just gets lazy.
At first, the charger pushes a steady, high current into the battery.
But around eighty percent, the cell's voltage hits its safe limit.
So the charger holds the voltage steady, and the current has to fall.
Forcing more in would mean heat and lithium plating, which permanently damage the battery.
Phones, laptops, even electric cars all follow the same rule.
Follow for more on how tech really works.
